claims.statement: Arvind Krishna is senior vice president and director of IBM Research, guiding the company's overall technical strategy and leading a global organization of approximately 3,000 scientists and technologists at 12 labs on six continents.

citations.quote: Arvind Krishna is senior vice president and director, IBM Research. In this role, he helps guide the company’s overall technical strategy, leading a global organization of approximately 3,000 scientists and technologists located at 12 labs on six continents.

claims.statement: Before leading IBM Research, Krishna was most recently general manager of IBM Systems and Technology Group's Development and Manufacturing organization, responsible for advanced engineering and development of a portfolio from advanced semiconductor materials to microprocessors, servers and storage systems.

citations.quote: Arvind was most recently general manager of IBM Systems and Technology Group’s Development and Manufacturing organization, responsible for the advanced engineering and development of a full technology portfolio, ranging from advanced semiconductor materials to leading-edge microprocessors, servers and storage systems.

claims.statement: Krishna was previously general manager of IBM Information Management, which included database, information integration and Big Data software solutions.

citations.quote: He was previously general manager of IBM Information Management, which included database, information integration and Big Data software solutions.

claims.statement: Krishna was previously vice president of strategy for IBM Software.

citations.quote: Prior to that, he was vice president of strategy for IBM Software.

claims.statement: Krishna has held several key technical roles in IBM Software and IBM Research, where he is credited with pioneering IBM's security software business.

citations.quote: He has held several key technical roles in IBM Software and IBM Research, where he pioneered IBM’s security software business.

claims.statement: Krishna holds an undergraduate degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur and a Ph.D. from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
